attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Ohio state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02: tax = max(AGI - $0 std ded, 0) x 3.5%. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Ohio Tax Calculation (top marginal 3.5%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.035 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " OH taxable income (AGI - $0): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " OH state tax (top marginal 3.5%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: OH: 3.5% x max(AGI - $0, 0) per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Ohio top-marginal-rate approximation per Ohio Rev. Code § 5747.02"
